badges.label: Installs and runs software packages from npm or PyPI
badges.detail: Installs a locked set of packages, at startup, without asking

badges.label: Downloads uv, and on Windows Microsoft's C++ runtime installer, when it first sets up its Python
badges.detail: It comes straight from Astral, who make uv, and Microsoft, who make the Visual C++ runtime, over an encrypted connection, as it would if you installed it yourself. The first time Zotero starts with it, it sets up its own Python: it downloads uv from Astral's GitHub releases if it can't find one on the computer, and on Windows, only when Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime is missing, that runtime's installer from Microsoft, which asks for administrator rights. Its README says both. Neither file is checked beyond its size and type.
